documentation_gaps.title: CANN version compatibility not clearly documented for master branch
documentation_gaps.body: README.md warns that master branch may have version mismatch with CANN, but does not specify the minimum CANN version required. version.cmake specifies set_cann_package VERSION 9.1.0 with build deps >=8.5, but this is not mentioned in README. Developers need to check version.cmake to determine compatible CANN version.

documentation_gaps.title: Sample code hardcodes deviceId=0
documentation_gaps.body: The example test_aclnn_add_example.cpp hardcodes deviceId=0. If NPU 0 is unavailable (faulty, in use, or not mounted in container), the sample fails. Documentation does not mention how to select a different device.

problems_encountered.problem: aclInit failed with error 500000 (soc version init failed) when running sample in Docker container without --privileged mode. DCMI could not initialize because NPU device access was restricted in standard Docker container.
problems_encountered.solution: Restarted container with --privileged --pid=host --ipc=host flags to grant full device access. This allowed DCMI to initialize and npu-smi to work correctly inside the container.

problems_encountered.problem: aclrtSetDevice(0) failed with error 507033 (device retain error) because NPU device 0 is in Critical (faulty) health state on the remote machine.
problems_encountered.solution: Modified sample code to use deviceId=1 (a working 910B3 NPU with OK health status). Sample then executed successfully with correct computation results.

problems_encountered.problem: CANN 9.0.0 in Docker image could not detect SoC version from host driver 25.5.0. Runtime errorCode 507008.
problems_encountered.solution: Mounted host's CANN 9.1.0 installation (which is compatible with driver 25.5.0) into the container by bind-mounting /usr/local/Ascend. Created symlinks so set_env.sh uses CANN 9.1.0 instead of 9.0.0.
problems_encountered.source: CANN version mismatch between Docker image (9.0.0) and host driver (25.5.0)
